(2) The scene cuts to a sidewalk where a small child with dark curly hair, wearing a white animal-patterned raincoat and blue pants, dances excitedly. In the background, parked motorbikes and a person in a gray shirt are seen under natural daylight. (3) Indoors, the two Corgis engage in a playful scuffle on a tiled floor near a black swivel chair. A white table displays a purple sign that reads '100 YEARS OF STORYTELLING'. The lighting is bright and indoor-based. (4) The child enters the frame and attempts to pet the dogs while they continue to play-fight and nip at each other. A person’s hand also reaches out to pet a dog. The dogs' mouths are open in playful barks. (5) The camera pans to reveal an older man sitting at a desk in the corner. Stacked cardboard boxes labeled '鳳梨梅汁' are visible in the background. The child continues to interact loudly with the boisterous Corgis near the black chair.
